title: Attention-cost log events and the replay report
description: The new log events and the replay tool that computes the attention-cost report as a pure function of the log (docs/design/attention-cost.md). Gate new behaviour on a *_SINCE constant and add it to replay in the same change.

title: Phase 8: evaluation and attention cost
description: The attention-cost measure: new log events, a replay tool that computes the report, the scripted operator, the scaling sweep, the harness for sessions with people (eval/). Exit: a scaling sweep report from the scripted operator at six fleet sizes, reproducible from the logs; a pilot protocol for human sessions written down. Design: docs/design/attention-cost.md. Only phase left on the critical path; blocks any claim about people.

title: Settle the attention-cost open questions before building
description: docs/design/attention-cost.md section 10: min_view_s as a labelled proxy for an informed decision; what counts as attended on a busy map; the 0.7 saturation threshold (literature or first scripted curve); who owns the truth-to-audit join (replay or eval/); an OpenMATB-style secondary task; group orders as one decision or weighted by vehicles. These shape the log events, and behaviour is versioned once shipped.

title: Run make check on the current head

title: Make the main menu offer only what this tree can run
description: make start opens eval/launcher.py's menu, which is Murmur machinery: the open world looks for sim/fleets/delivery.toml (the fleet is delivery-demo.toml) and runs make goldengate, situations run make situation / eval.situation_run, and neither target exists. The three delivery scenarios in sim/scenarios (harbour-city, wind-event, coastal-boat, started by scripts/scenario.sh) are not offered. make start fails at once with 'no fleet .../delivery.toml'. Workaround: make start SCENARIO=harbour-city.

title: Remove or rebuild the situation runner
description: eval/situation.py, eval/situation_run.py, web/src/SituationPanel.tsx and GET /api/situation are Murmur's situation machinery: sim/situations does not exist, there is no make situation target, and the menu no longer offers situations (fleetmesh-x3k). Remove it, or rebuild guided runs (opening orders, a scripted operator, an AI watch officer) on the delivery scenarios. Stale make goldengate references remain in crates/fleetmesh-linkemu/README.md and tidewater/README.md.
